change.description: Add crash-safe autonomous archive recovery finalization and quarantine retirement, bounded historical raw-file reconciliation, an additive raw-capture circuit contract, a separately scheduled bounded orphan sweep with admission liveness and durable progress evidence, and System Status health fields.
change.release_unit_description: Autonomous retention recovery, raw capture circuit breaker, and raw orphan sweep throughput.

planned.reasoning: The system-status fields are optional/additive; new counters may be unknown until measured. New SQLite tables, raw-capture columns, and nullable raw_payload_files evidence columns are additive and earlier binaries may ignore them. No existing field or archive format is changed.

scope_drift.description: No public API or durable-state compatibility scope drift.

current.reasoning: The candidate adds optional runtimePressureHealth.rawOrphanSweep diagnostics and additive raw reconciliation release-pending timestamp/evidence-persisted columns alongside nullable admission/settled-pass/removal evidence on the existing raw_payload_files cursor. Earlier binaries remain safe because their bounded filename cursor wraps through the tail and ignore unknown columns; archive wire/file formats and existing response fields remain unchanged. Every bounded raw filesystem inspection uses FIFO background-slot and bounded maintenance-write admission, with the background pressure slot retained only for the inspection while the SQLite write-coordinator permit is released; mid-pass candidates remain pending, pending recovery has a bounded share, and unlink counts/bytes are transactionally recorded before ledger cleanup.

The raw orphan evidence migration is additive and idempotent; System Status diagnostics remain optional and additive. Each unrelated timing-sensitive failure observed in a full shared-testbox profile passed in an independent run of the same profile.
